about: PNC Infratech Limited was incorporated on 9th August 1999 as PNC Construction Company Private Limited. The Company was converted into a limited company in 2001 and was renamed PNC Infratech limited in 2007. PNC Infratech Limited is one of the front-ending infrastructure development, construction, and management companies in the country.
